rows.note: Use this for two people in a romantic or sexual relationship, rather than merely a pair of people.

example.english: That couple eats together all the time.
example.traditional: 嗰對情侶成日一齊食飯。
example.jyutping: go2 deoi3 cing4 leoi5 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for two matching or associated things considered as a pair, including a romantic couple when the pair is viewed as a unit.

example.english: I bought a couple of matching sneakers.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 bo1 haai4

rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when “a couple of” simply means exactly two people or things, such as two police officers.

example.english: A couple of police officers are standing at the door.
example.jyutping: go2 loeng5 go3 caai1 jan4 kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this when “a couple” means a small number, specifically around two or three.

example.english: I still have a couple of questions to ask.
example.traditional: 我仲有兩三個問題想問。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 loeng5 saam1 go3 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6
